answer: Require each agent to post a bond that is locked until it completes a task and survives a random audit; suspected duplicate identities are clustered by shared funding and behavior, then challenged together. A beacon can announce the audit, while a cipher commits to the agent’s evidence beforehand so it cannot be changed after the challenge. If a cluster fails, its bonds are slashed. Creating many fake agents therefore ties up real capital and risks losing it, while the audit makes cheap identity churn costly even in a canyon of accounts.
